data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2022 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding was $1,075.05m. Using the gross claims development triangle (excluding the aggregated '2012 & prior' column and excluding the two most recent underwriting years), prior-year development produced a net gross strengthening of approximately $8.96m (about 0.83% of opening gross reserves). Management attribute the reserve movement primarily to adverse development on older casualty/treaty lines (2019 and prior), impacts from geopolitical events (War in Ukraine), natural catastrophe exposure in 2022 (Hurricane Ian, Winterstorm Elliott) and the effect of high economic inflation on claims costs and IBNR assumptions.
raw_causal_phrases: strengthened its 2019 and prior year of account reserves primarily in its Casualty Treaty, Management & Transactional Liability and Contractors Liability classes.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was not explicitly stated in a single 'movement in prior year' gross figure. The prior-year development figure reported above (8.96) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative incurred estimates) by summing diagonal movements for underwriting years 2013-2020 per the methodology in the extraction rules. The report also provides net prior-year deterioration ($10.253m) and a prior-period restatement affecting reinsurers' share ($5.962m). Amounts shown have been converted from the reported $000 into millions and rounded to two decimal places where appropriate.
